title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting with Physics-Indexed Specialist Memory: the Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.21598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual reinforcement learning requires adaptation to changing conditions while preserving performance under previously encountered dynamics. It was investigated whether specialists generated by evolutionary search can provide a reusable memory when combined with environment detection and failure-driven search. The Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent (ENA) evolves small neural networks without gradients, archives selected policies by detected dynamic regime, and retrieves them through Bayesian policy reuse. The architecture was evaluated in non-stationary CartPole and HalfCheetah environments. In the 30-replicate CartPole ablation, the complete architecture achieved a mean success rate of 83.2% across the five test environments. Among variants that learned the harder CartPole environments, the complete architecture showed the most consistent retention. translated_title: 通过物理索引的专家记忆缓解灾难性遗忘：进化神经可塑性智能体
translated_abstract: 持续强化学习要求智能体在适应不断变化的条件的同时，保持在先前遇到的动态环境下的性能。本研究探讨了由进化搜索生成的专家策略在与环境检测和失败驱动搜索相结合时，能否提供可复用的记忆。进化神经可塑性智能体（ENA）在不使用梯度的情况下进化小型神经网络，按检测到的动态状态归档选定的策略，并通过贝叶斯策略复用来检索这些策略。该架构在非平稳CartPole和HalfCheetah环境中进行了评估。在30次重复的CartPole消融实验中，完整架构在五个测试环境中取得了83.2%的平均成功率。在学习了较难CartPole环境的各个变体中，完整架构表现出最一致的性能保持能力。选择消融实验还表明，检索规则会影响性能。在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出进化神经可塑性智能体（ENA），通过无梯度进化神经网络、按动态状态归档策略并利用贝叶斯策略复用进行检索，有效缓解了非平稳强化学习中的灾难性遗忘，在CartPole消融实验中达到83.2%的平均成功率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Evolutionary Neuroplastic Agent (ENA), which evolves gradient-free small neural networks, archives policies by detected dynamic regimes, and retrieves them via Bayesian policy reuse to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in non-stationary reinforcement learning, achieving an 83.2% mean success rate in CartPole ablation experiments.
